verdict.rationale: Live in-app updates across open sessions is a fair question for a collaborative work-management tool like Asana, but nothing in the evidence pack documents changes appearing instantly in other users' sessions. Webhooks that notify external applications of changes are a developer building block, and the 'real-time 2-way sync' claim belongs to a third-party GitLab integration; neither is the in-UI live update this story asks about.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
